plan: Drive: from District of Hudsons Hope, about 62 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Canyon Dr, Hwy 29 (Beattie Dr), Hwy 29, Jackfish Lake Rd.
Park: 56.01703, -121.26151, where the truck road ends (resource road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 1.5 km on unnamed roads and trails by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 60 m SW, climb about 0 m.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2007 cutblock (right here) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-32, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
